headline: Week 6 early look: St. Brown, Jefferson and Hockenson are on bye, so Golden and Downs move into the WR slots.
alerts: Lions and Vikings are on bye. Bench St. Brown, Jefferson and Hockenson before Sunday 10 AM.
Sunday 10 AM locks: Hurts, Robinson, Downs, Jets DEF. 1:05 PM: Brissett. 1:25 PM: Mitchell. 5:20 PM: Golden, Lloyd, Ferguson. Monday 5:15 PM: McLaurin.
London game (Texans at Jaguars) is Sunday 6:30 AM. None of your players are in it.
Jets DEF faces a 25-point Patriots implied total. Look for a streaming defense and a kicker on waivers.
Sleeper could not be reached this run, so roster and opponent were not refreshed. Lines are early lookahead numbers, and the Saturday review will update them.

comparisons.why: Hurts has the higher implied total and a rushing floor. Brissett could pile up garbage-time volume as a big underdog. Low confidence, revisit Saturday.
McLaurin looked healthy in Week 5 and gets a 50.5 total on Monday night. Mitchell faces a tough spot as a 7.5-point underdog in Kansas City.
Lloyd is at home in a 50.5 total with Green Bay projected near 24 points. Mitchell's team projects near 19. Close call.
